story: Tuesday 20 October is not a PGA Tour round. The Butterfield Bermuda Championship is 22-25 October 2026 at Port Royal Golf Course in Southampton, the eighth playing. The PGA Tour lists a 120-player field, a $6 million purse, a winner's share of $1.08 million and 500 FedExCup points. The cut is the low 65 and ties after 36 holes. Golf Channel's first-round coverage is 1:00 p.m. ET on Thursday. Past champions in the field: Brendon Todd (2019), Seamus Power (2022), Camilo Villegas (2023), Rafael Campos (2024) and defending champion Adam Schenk (2025). Michael Brennan's Baycurrent win still stands: a closing 68, a total of 268, 16 under, and $1.44 million. There is no Tuesday leader. The course is listed at 6,828 yards, par 71.
stakes: The next PGA Tour start is 22 October. Nothing in Bermuda has been played.
